mapper.select: SELECT t.*,k.*, ( SELECT NAME FROM inspection.cm_guoku_talentpool a WHERE a.UUID = t.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER ) AS USER_NAME, ( SELECT e.ENUM_DSCR FROM enumset.cm_guoku_enumeration e WHERE e.ENUM_TYPE_ID = '7' AND e.ENUM_ID = t.INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES ) as DUTIES_DSCR FROM inspection.inspection_group_user t JOIN inspection.inspection_group i ON t.INSPECTION_GROUP_ID = i.INSPECTION_GROUP_ID JOIN inspection.inspection_task k ON i.INSPECTION_TASK_ID = k.INSPECTION_TASK_ID WHERE t.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER = #{params.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER} AND ( ( #{params.END_TIME} >= k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND #{params.END_TIME} <= k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) OR ( #{params.BEGIN_TIME} < k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND #{params.END_TIME} > k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) OR ( #{params.BEGIN_TIME} >= k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND #{params.BEGIN_TIME} <= k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) )
